info.name: Oxa Backend API - Comprehensive Test Suite
info.description: Postman v2.1.0 collection converted and expanded from the Jest/Supertest suite for the Oxa backend (MongoDB-backed, running at {{BASE_URL}}). Covers authentication, session/profile endpoints, contact management, general negative/validation cases, and targeted NoSQL injection & input-sanitization checks. Run folder-by-folder, in order, using the Collection Runner - state (test identities, JWT, contact id) is created once and threaded through subsequent requests via collection variables.
